g.text: Does the frozen model beat a simple prediction?
DESCRIPTIVE OUTCOME AUDIT. The constant rule is fixed by the 2013J training majority (438 positive of 757); it always predicts Pass/Distinction. On
the 973 later audit records, logistic accuracy is 541/973 (55.60%); the simple baseline is 547/973 (56.22%). The logistic model does beat the baseline
in the earlier audit. Predicting everyone positive gives both TPR and FPR of 100%. These selected-cohort rates have no claimed population confidence
intervals. No classifier tuning was performed.
